dictionary.approved_by: Committee or officer that accepted it.
dictionary.approved_on: Date the concern was accepted at approval.
dictionary.article: CBUAE CRM article the item relates to.
dictionary.book: The credit book the client belongs to (corporate).
dictionary.critical: A missed critical item escalates on its own.
dictionary.currency: Currency of the original exposure (SAR or AED).

ecl_stage2_sar_mn.description: ECL if moved to Stage 2 (lifetime PD on Stage 1 facilities).

dictionary.ews_score: Early Warning score (highest over the client's exposures).
dictionary.exposure_ccy_mn: Exposure in the original currency, million.

exposure_sar_mn.description: Exposure, SAR million (AED converted at the peg).

dictionary.frequency: How often the item is checked.
dictionary.metric: What is measured to judge the trigger.
dictionary.name: Client name.
dictionary.no_sicr_rationale: Why the concern was accepted without a SICR at approval.
dictionary.obligor_id: Borrower ID (CB… in the book; UAE-… for proposal cases).
dictionary.rating: Internal rating at the as-of quarter.
dictionary.source: book (a borrower of the corporate book) or proposal (a Deal Desk proposal case, AED).
dictionary.stage: Worst IFRS 9 stage of the client's facilities.
dictionary.trigger: The watch item: what must happen.
